profile.headline: Software Engineer at Public Consulting Group
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the aviation and aerospace industry. Skilled in C#, CSS, HTML, Javascript, SQL, Java, XML, C, C++, PHP, Python. Strong business development professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Computer Science from Old Dominion University.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: I develop and maintain enterprise C# business applications using ASP.Net MVC, utilizing Bootstrap as a front end framework. I also develop and maintain customizations in our ERP (Baan/LN) and Teamcenter environments.  I also provide support for mentoring for other junior level programmers and report writers in our group.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I primarily developed software for circuit level hardware electronics testing. In doing so I also authored requirements and test procedure documents that were used by technicians to perform test and repair of digital electronic circuits. Additionally, I designed and programmed circuits, including FPGA programming via VHDL.

positions.title: Automation Intern
positions.description: I designed and authored internal software for data collection and statistical analysis. I helped to administer the IBM content management system. I help maintain the organization's domain and network security, which included the digital handling of classified information. I provided IT support to the users in the department.
